passage:
We built an aqueous organic redox flow battery from a methyl viologen anolyte and a TEMPO-based catholyte.
Both electrolytes were pumped through graphite felt electrodes on either side of an anion-exchange membrane.
Over 300 cycles the MV/TEMPO cell kept 94% of its initial discharge capacity.
For comparison, a vanadium redox flow battery with the same electrodes was cycled under identical conditions.
